# Persian Data Grid for React

> RTL / Jalali data grid: Excel-like keyboard, virtual scroll, IndexedDB, Excel/PDF plugins.

- Demo: https://hamidrezafallahi.github.io/ERP-Table/
- Guide: https://hamidrezafallahi.github.io/ERP-Table/guide/
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/persian-data-grid
- GitHub: https://github.com/hamidrezafallahi/ERP-Table

## Install

```bash
npm i persian-data-grid
```

## Search intents

- persian data grid react
- jalali data grid
- react table rtl
- گرید فارسی react
- دیتاگرید شمسی

## Exports

- Grid component
- VirtualList
- ExcelExportPlugin / ExcelImportPlugin
- PdfExportPlugin
- GridSession / UITableController
